title: Real-time Base mainnet gas prices via direct RPC eth_feeHistory — slow/standard/
description: Real-time Base mainnet gas prices via direct RPC eth_feeHistory — slow/standard/fast tiers (max_fee_per_gas + max_priority_fee_per_gas in gwei), current EIP-1559 base fee, latest block number, and median block fullness across the last 20 blocks. Use for fee estimation, tx scheduling, and base-chain congestion signals.

_signals.x_guidance: Cheapest agent-native source for Base mainnet gas. Call GET /v1/base/gas before submitting any on-chain tx to pick a fair maxFeePerGas + maxPriorityFeePerGas, or before deciding whether to wait out congestion. Optionally pass ?blocks=N to widen or narrow the percentile sample (1..50, default 20). $0.001 USDC per call, settled instantly via x402 on Base.
